inlines.v: ES'TIMABLE, adjective 1. That is capable of being estimated or valued; as estimable damage. 2. Valuable; worth a great price. A pound of man's flesh, taken from a man, Is not so estimable or profitable. 3. Worthy of esteem or respect; deserving our good opinion or regard. A lady said of her two companions, that one was more amiable, the other more estimable ES'TIMABLE, noun That which is worthy of regard.
